cues.zh: 這表示，模型內部處理這兩種文法詞類的方式，有相當強的分歧。

cues.zh: 順帶補充，如果好奇這是否只是因為

cues.zh: 主成分分析正負號的任意性，那其實無法解釋，因為正負號不定性會翻轉整個軸。

cues.en: If you have no idea what I'm talking about, this is a important but nuanced detail of principal components analysis.
cues.zh: 如果不知道我在說什麼，這是主成分分析中，重要但細膩的細節。

cues.zh: 對每個個別層，我只是看每個連續點之間的距離，

cues.zh: 也就是每層這個點與這個點。

cues.en: Well the title of this video is all about whether nouns or adjectives have longer trajectories.
cues.zh: 影片標題是在問，名詞或形容詞，哪個軌跡更長。

cues.en: We have not yet approached that question, but that is the goal here.
cues.zh: 還沒處理這個問題，但這裡就是目標。

cues.en: So what you will need to do for this exercise is calculate the distance between each successive point in this plot.
cues.zh: 這個練習，需要計算這張圖中，每個連續點之間的距離。

cues.en: Now, this is not a plot you need to create here for exercise five.
cues.zh: 練習五不需要建立這張圖，

cues.en: It's literally the plot that you created in exercise four.
cues.zh: 它就是練習四建立的圖，

cues.en: I just put it here for illustration.
cues.zh: 只是放在這裡示範。

cues.en: So the distance metric that you calculated in the previous exercise, that was the distance between nouns and adjectives within each layer.
cues.zh: 上一個練習算的距離，是每層內，名詞與形容詞之間的距離。

cues.en: But that is not what you want to calculate here for the trajectory path distance.
cues.zh: 但那不是這裡要計算的軌跡路徑距離。

cues.en: Instead here you want to calculate the distance traveled by this particle going from layer to layer or this vector within each category.
cues.zh: 這裡要算的是，這個粒子、這個向量，在每個類別內，從一層到下一層，移動了多遠，

cues.en: For each layer relative to the previous layer.
cues.zh: 也就是每層相對於前一層。

cues.en: Okay, so the idea is to imagine that these are like hiking trails.
cues.zh: 好，想像這些是登山步道。

cues.en: These are two hiking trails here, the Red trail and the Blue Trail.
cues.zh: 這裡有兩條步道，紅色與藍色，

cues.en: And you're walking along these hiking trails.
cues.zh: 你沿著它們行走，

cues.en: And the question is which of these two trails is longer?
cues.zh: 問題是，哪條比較長？

cues.en: So you calculate the Euclidean distance from each layer Relative to the previous layer.
cues.zh: 所以計算每層相對於前一層的歐幾里得距離，

cues.en: In other words, the Euclidean distance from each point to the next point in this trajectory.
cues.zh: 也就是軌跡中每個點到下一個點的歐幾里得距離。

cues.en: Now I decided to implement this analysis twice.
cues.zh: 我決定將分析實作兩次，

cues.en: I did it once in a for loop.
cues.zh: 一次用 for 迴圈，

cues.en: So looping over all the layers.
cues.zh: 逐一迭代所有層。

cues.en: And I did that because it really helped me think about how the analysis works mechanistically, and
cues.zh: 這麼做，確實幫助我從機制上思考分析如何運作，

cues.en: also how the distance is calculated between each successive pair of layers within each part of speech category.
cues.zh: 也思考每個詞性類別內，連續層配對之間的距離如何計算。

cues.en: But it turns out that you do not need for loops to run this calculation.
cues.zh: 但其實，不需要 for 迴圈，

cues.en: You can actually do the whole thing vectorized without any loops.
cues.zh: 整件事可以向量化，不用任何迴圈。

cues.en: Now, my personal preference with coding is that I generally find for loops easier to understand.
cues.zh: 我個人寫程式，一般覺得 for 迴圈比較容易理解，

cues.en: But of course vectorized code is more efficient and less prone to coding errors, and it's often faster anyway, as long as you get the right answer, it's fine.
cues.zh: 但向量化更有效率、較不容易有程式錯誤，而且通常更快。總之，答案正確就可以。

cues.en: So these two plots here show the main results that you want to generate in exercise five.
cues.zh: 這兩張圖，是練習五要產生的主要結果。

cues.en: Here on the left we have the token distances over all of the layers.
cues.zh: 左邊是所有層的 token 距離，

cues.en: So you're going to have two lines in this plot.
cues.zh: 圖上會有兩條線，

cues.en: One for the nouns and one for the adjectives.
cues.zh: 一條名詞，一條形容詞。

cues.en: And the y axis is the distance between each layer and the previous layer within the same category.
cues.zh: y 軸是同一類別內，每層與前一層之間的距離。

cues.en: Now these distances can get really big, especially towards the end of the path towards the end of the trajectory.
cues.zh: 這些距離可能很大，尤其路徑、軌跡的末端。

cues.en: So therefore, what I did and what I recommend doing is plotting the log of the distances instead of the linear distance.
cues.zh: 所以我做的，也是建議的，是畫距離的對數，而不是線性距離。

cues.en: That just facilitates visual interpretation, as I've mentioned earlier in the course that log scaling
cues.zh: 這有助於視覺解讀，課程前面提過，當圖中數值差異

cues.en: is often done in machine learning and statistics, when there are really large differences between the numerical values in the plot.
cues.zh: 非常大時，機器學習與統計經常使用對數尺度。

cues.en: Anyway, once you have those two lines for nouns and adjectives, then you can just literally subtract the two layer by layer and show those results over here.
cues.zh: 總之，有了名詞與形容詞兩條線，就能逐層直接相減，在這裡顯示結果。

cues.en: So this is literally just the difference of the log distances for nouns versus adjectives.
cues.zh: 這真的只是名詞與形容詞，對數距離的差。

cues.en: Okay.
cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: But importantly, you know, this exercise is not just about generating a plot.
cues.zh: 但重要的是，這個練習不只是產生圖形。

cues.en: So before you create this graph, before you look at the results, I want you to think again about which way you predict the results to come out.
cues.zh: 建立圖形、看結果之前，希望你再次思考，自己預測結果會朝哪邊走。

cues.en: Do you think that nouns or adjectives have longer trajectories in this state space?

cues.zh: 根據你對兩者需要多少處理與 token 整合的想法，做出預測。

cues.zh: 很好。

cues.zh: 好。

cues.en: And then the two is for the two different categories of words.
cues.zh: 2 則表示兩種不同字詞類別。

cues.en: So here I get the x points and the y points of this here.
cues.zh: 這裡取得 x 點與 y 點，

cues.en: So you know for any given point here I have two x coordinates that I need to calculate Euclidean distance.
cues.zh: 對任何一個點，都有兩個要拿來算歐幾里得距離的 x 座標，

cues.zh: 現在是向量，
